book.name: ABA VATOWO
book.title: Aba Vatowo Kaga liliuna adi kaba vatowo tetelina

content: Daina be da Sekem tetelidi
E Yakobo mana bodao asa Sekem goi sikaaiyaka go, tuta tayamo Reya be Yakobo natudi Daina iketoiya ina bego vevina asa goi ivadadedi.
Ego koroto tayamo yoina Sekem ikaaiyaka, tauyana Emori natuna; ina bodao yoidi Ivai.
Emoriyana asa Sekem ana tolovina. E kina Daina isiu asayana goi Sekemyana ikandobala Daina igite, tuwo ina ivinayoisi imasisiye, e igieomaemae.
Ikavava, Dainayana maisina ivakone. Tuwo Sekemyana nuwona ikabi toina; latuwona inai. Tuwo ilumakikine bego itagona taiyao sinai.
E ina tamana Emori ilatuwoko idigo kana, ‘Tamagu, kom kūna amo vavinayana kwābi yau monegu.’
E Yakobo vala inove bego natuna Daina kina Sekem igieomaemae. Yakobo natunao koroto nava sikaaiyaka náuna moteoina goi yoguyogu simatakaavatedi. Tuwo imaigau ana kadókana sikaluvila.
E Sekem tamana Emori ina Yakobo igite bego Daina manuna ibóbwara.

E kidi go tutayana Yakobo natunao náuna moteoina goi sima, livalayana sinove, e tauyadi gamodi igoyo be nakae nuwodi imou sidigo kadi, ‘Moe sinapuyana aba omayamaya gagaina yaima.’ (Moitamo Isileli goi geya itoboineyeta.)
Go kina Emoriyana Yakobo ilatuwoko idigo kana, ‘Go natugu Sekem natum nukotona ikabi toina. Tauna natugu kuvīni bego monena.
Kutagōna bei ida bodao taiyao sinai. Kai ima tubuwau imi wowoiyai sikabidi monediyao go, kai nakae ima wowoiyai imi tubuwau sikabidi monediyao.
Ameko goi kokaiyāka. Ava poyapoya latuwomi, kokābi go, kopaisēwa be nakae poyapoya kogimōna.’
E Sekemyana nakae ibóbwara, Daina tamana be niunao ilatuwokoidi idigo kana, ‘Neta itoboinegu im kanuwóiya ababane, e kaga latuwomi bei avinimi.
Komi toinimi kolovina Daina buwona. Kolatuwokoigu, bei avinimi. Neta gagaina, tuwo bei avinimi. Ago Daina kovinīgu monegu.’
Go boi kidi Yakobo natunao gamodi igoyo, tuwo sipola unana niudi Sekem igieomaemae. Tauna sipola
sidigo kadi, ‘Geya itoboinemeta niuma kavinim. Kom sakavaim geya kukupoeta. Neta kavinim, moe aba omayamaya gagaina yaima.
Go sem tayamo dogoi koguinuweyāmo. Ame nakae: Neta komi koroto madabokimi asa goi sakavaimi kokupoidi, bei komi kai nakae.
Kokupoidi ikavava, natumao vevina kavinimi go, natumiyao vevina kakabidi. E kai ameko bei kalokasa, nakae kita taeboda tayamo.
Go neta sakavaimi geya kokupoidita, e niuma kakabi, taiyao kana.’
E idi livalayadi Emori ma natuna Sekem sinove, tuwo sidigo kadi, ‘Dedevina, katagona.’
Sekem, tauyana koroto gagaina Emori ina bodao yaidi, woilina ina nakae iguinuwe. Bogina kuyagoi. Sekemyana Daina nuwona ikabi toina.
E moitamo Emori ma natuna Sekem sina idi kasa ana kaba siu goi sediyao silatuwokoidi kadi,
‘Tawou, amo korotoyadi dedevidi, tauyadi sikabivekovekoema. Tauna tatagōna sikaaiyaka ida poyapoya goi sipaaisewa. Ego konōve. Natudiyao vevina tanaidi go, natudao vevina sikabidi sinaidi.
Go tayamo dogoi sikawanoiye yaida. Tauyadi bei sitagona sikaaiyaka yaida, neta kita sakavaida takupoidi kidi nakae.
Go kogita. Idi yoguyoguyao be nakae idi poyapoya ana madabokina takabidi ae? Tauna kotagōna sakavaimi kokupoidi go, sikaaiyaka yaida.’
Tuwo koroto liliudi asa ana kaba siu goi Emori ma natuna Sekem idi livala sinovedi, e sikabikaonedi. Tauna koroto madabokidi sakavaidi sikupoidi.

E maliyalina aito sikavava, korotoyadi sakavaidi adi kúpwana ana gedageda nava siilotowo go, idi lotówana kidi dedevidi. Ago Yakobo natunao, Simion be Livai, tauyadi Daina niunao, idi sisi sikabidi, sina asayana goi koroto liliudi sivaopedi sikaumatedi.
Emori ma natuna Sekem nakae sikaumatedi. Sikaumatedi ikavava, niudi Daina Sekem ina vada goi sikabi sinave.
E kidi go Yakobo natunaoyadi liliudi asa sinaena sivabebeo kónana sivaináwana tokámasa yaidi. Moe niudi ana omayamaya ana katumapu.
Tokámasa idi yoguyoguyao sikabidi, moe sipi, goti, bulumakau be nakae ase. Konadi liliudi idi vada sinaedi be nakae idi kasa goi nakae sikabidi.
Ego idi esaesa madabokina, vevina be gogómana liliudi sikoyoinidi sinavedi.

E kina Yakoboyana natunao idi guinuwa igite natunao adi taiyuwo ilatuwokoidi idigo kana, ‘Simion be Livai, ami taiyuwo imi guinuwa goi yau guna mou koyato. Ame tutayana da Kenani be nakae da Perisi bei sikaolilivegu go, tauyadi toni kasa! Kita geya tabadebadeta. Tauna neta silamgógana sima silauida, e kita be ida bodao liliudi bei tavailai!’
Go kidi Simion be Livai sidigo kadi, ‘Manakae? Dedevina katagona bego niuma siyatako kina tomatagogoli nakae?’

footnotes.text: Ivai: Emori tubuna yoina Ivai go, niga Ivaiyana tubunao toinidi siduduwedi kadi, ‘Kai yoima Ivai.’
